title: Honest Inference with Weakly Separated Close Donor Groups in Few-Treated Panels
banked_reason: The advertised weak-separation panel frontier is not proved: its exact value uses a repaired score-only experiment with b observed noiselessly, while admissible panel effect contrasts vanish at O(n^-1/2).
gap_reasons: The exact value solves a bounded-spread score-only experiment with b observed noiselessly, not the proposal's matching local-minimax expected-diameter frontier for panel triangular arrays; the stated transfer node expressly leaves that loss and coverage transfer open.

The advertised weak-separation panel frontier is not proved over the panel triangular-array experiment: the exact minimax value concerns a repaired experiment that observes b without noise and imposes a bounded effect spread.

Hence on the advertised root-n-local score class, all effect contrasts satisfy max_k|b_{k,n}-tau_n|=O(n^(-1/2)). They cannot converge to the fixed, unequally spaced b* grid used by the lower bound of thm:score-face-general-minimax-exact.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 proved a totalized simultaneous hull, a pilot-screened oracle construction, and exact two-face Gaussian bounds, then repaired the finite frontier by observing b noiselessly. D0.5 and the independent validity gate showed that this repair launders the advertised panel problem: additive transport and bounded covariance make every effect contrast O(n^(-1/2)) under root-n-local score separation, so the fixed positive-spread least-favorable grid is inadmissible. A future topic may study the genuinely noisy sqrt(n)-scaled local experiment, but it needs a new proposal.
tldr: A finite menu of prespecified donor stacks creates nonregular inference when validity is defined by an exact zero of a noisy baseline score. The panel procedures remain causal only under the explicit nonempty exact-close and shared-slope additive untreated-change conditions; zero score alone does not imply target coherence in the abstract Gaussian limit. The unrestricted-effect full Gaussian frontier is infinite. In the repaired bounded-spread score-only benchmark, \(b\) is observed exactly and only root-sample-scaled scores remain Gaussian: its exact honest expected-diameter value is zero for \(J=1\) and \(B(1-J\alpha/(J-1))\) for \(J\geq2\) and \(0<\alpha<1/2\), for arbitrary positive definite shared-control covariance and including multiple-close-donor faces. A data-free randomized hull attains the value; the covariance-aware deterministic score screen remains an honest operational comparator. The two-state subproblem retains the sharper separation-dependent value \(\Delta[\Phi(z_{1-\alpha}-\rho)-\alpha]_+\). Finite-sample transfer remains limited to bounded uniformly equicontinuous risk payoffs, and none of these conditional results validates the historical CMS comparison-state estimates.
gap: Existing few-treated panel methods use many untreated groups, synthetic-control methods use long time series, and generic post-selection methods do not optimize confidence-set diameter for a target whose label is defined by an exact zero score.
fill: The project derives exact-close transport by iterated expectations under an almost-sure shared-slope untreated-change model, supplies falsifying calibration and placebo diagnostics, proves conditional uniform validity and fixed-separation oracle behavior for a spectrally clipped joint inversion, solves the embedded two-donor honest-diameter problem exactly, and leaves general face-adaptive minimaxity and restricted QMD reduced-experiment transfer as explicit open questions.
